# Wuttichai Sukantho

> Wuttichai Sukantho (วุฒิชัย สุคันโซ), also known as Bomb, is the person represented by this public portfolio.

Wuttichai Sukantho is a software developer in Thailand focused on TypeScript, backend systems, APIs, and maintainable web applications.
The same public profile may also be recognized as Wuttichai Sukanto or by the Thai nickname บอม.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://wuttichaisukantho.github.io/wuttichai.github.io/): profile overview and current technical focus.
- [Playground](https://wuttichaisukantho.github.io/wuttichai.github.io/#playground): interactive character, item, collision, and leaderboard systems.
- [About](https://wuttichaisukantho.github.io/wuttichai.github.io/#about-hero): developer background and technical interests.
- [Experience](https://wuttichaisukantho.github.io/wuttichai.github.io/#experience): public work and education timeline entries.
- [Education](https://wuttichaisukantho.github.io/wuttichai.github.io/#education): academic milestones.
- [Profile Stats](https://wuttichaisukantho.github.io/wuttichai.github.io/#profile-stats): counts derived from the public profile data.
- [Tech Stack](https://wuttichaisukantho.github.io/wuttichai.github.io/#tech-stack): technologies and architecture used by this website.
- [Contact](https://wuttichaisukantho.github.io/wuttichai.github.io/#contact): public social and professional profiles.

## Technical profile

- TypeScript, React, Bun, Elysia, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, and Docker.
- Backend development, API engineering, system architecture, and maintainable web applications.
- The site uses React, TanStack Start, TanStack Router, MobX, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS, and GitHub Pages.

This file summarizes public portfolio content. The website is the canonical source for the latest profile details.
